# NFL Daily — 2026-11-26 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Steelers waived QB Aaron Rodgers after he said on "The Pat McAfee Show" that coach Mike McCarthy had been sleeping through team meetings; NFL sources corroborated the allegations, and owner Art Rooney said he has "100% confidence" in McCarthy. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50595660/rodgers-heard-mccarthy-benching) — also [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50605070/steelers-owner-disappointed-rodgers-backs-mccarthy)
- Rams S Kam Kinchens was ejected for a helmet-to-helmet hit on Packers WR Christian Watson, who was ruled out with a concussion, as L.A. won its fifth straight game on Thanksgiving Eve. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50600753/rams-kam-kinchens-ejected-hit-christian-watson)
- Packers' Micah Parsons, back from injury, said he was "highly, highly disappointed" with the defense after Green Bay allowed a season-high 241 rushing yards in the loss to the Rams. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50602564/packers-micah-parsons-accountability-rams-return)
- Chargers QB Justin Herbert is in the NFL's concussion protocol and didn't practice again Wednesday; L.A. signed QB Jake Browning to the active roster for depth. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2126023387025981636)
- 49ers QB Brock Purdy did not practice Wednesday with an ankle injury from Sunday night's loss to the Vikings. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2125752742451032296)
- Bears TE Colston Loveland was carted off and ruled out for the rest of Thursday's game at Detroit with a knee injury. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50605365/bears-colston-loveland-ruled-vs-lions-knee-injury)
- Ravens RB Derrick Henry was limited in practice Wednesday while in the NFL's concussion protocol ahead of Thursday's game at Houston. [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2125730054424391777)
